name: zclass_object3d_model_ref_lerp_queue_update
description: zClass_Object3D_ModelRefLerpQueue::Update advances object alpha/model-ref lerp tasks, invokes completion callbacks, updates lighting, and removes completed tasks from the queue.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 owner target zclass_model_ref_lerp_queue_owner now matches 0x4381d0 with zero unmasked mismatches after 88 relocation bytes and 15 trimmed VC5 NOPs, BN size 369 bytes and VC5 size 384 bytes. Binary Ninja currently has an fstp flag-generation limitation at 0x438209, so the x87 compare/clamp logic was read from assembly. The sibling ClearGlobalState authored body is 0x438000; 0x437fe4 pre-body padding and 0x437ff0 CRT initializer thunk are provider-boundary artifacts.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4381d0 verifies count/head early-outs, currentModelRef += modelRefDeltaPerSec * g_FrameDeltaTimeSec, clamp to 0..1, inverted alpha application, gwObject3DSetAlphaScale, completion when currentModelRef >= targetModelRef, fastcall onComplete(callbackCtx), gwObject3DSetLitFlag(node, 0) when applied alpha is 1, next-task preservation, head/interior unlink, tail repair, and operator delete. The native smoke covers completed head and tail tasks around a surviving middle task, callback order, alpha updates, lighting effects, and queue count/head/tail repair.
